paper_title: Distributed Query Monitoring through Convex Analysis: Towards Composable Safe Zones
statement: Important problems remain open for future research, mainly relating the quality of safe zones to actual guarantees on the communication cost of monitoring, and extending our compositional approach beyond boolean, to other types of composite queries.
context: In this paper, we have presented the first formal framework for the compositional design of convex Safe Zones (SZs), for problems with separable constraints. To this end, we have introduced a functional safe zone representation that conserves, under Boolean composition, the quality guarantees of their component constraints. We have also applied our new framework to general function monitoring scenarios of practical interest. Important problems remain open for future research, mainly relating the quality of safe zones to actual guarantees on the communication cost of monitoring, and extending our compositional approach beyond boolean, to other types of composite queries. 1 The problem of communication lower bounds for general functions under the cash-register model remains open.
